meaning: The clocks that the values of three scaffold-recordings builds belong to: agricultural science (no dip and no difference between the game and the simulator after its staged start), agricultural science with backed-up belts (no difference between the game and the simulator), and the inserters moved_open names for chemical science with a shared foundry. Each build is named as in scaffold-recordings.game.test.ts, its config by the ConfigPaths key; `clock_sha256` is the sha256 of the identity (clockIdentity) of the clock the generator selects for it. The game test refuses to run on another clock and scaffold-recordings-clock.generation.test.ts checks the selection (the two agricultural science builds on the generations of agricultural-science.generation.test.ts and clock-belt.generation.test.ts), so a clock that moves is found before those values are taken for the new clock's. The values of chemical science with a shared foundry were recorded on 2026-10-15 and 2026-10-16 on its clock (1 output swing per cycle), whose hash was taken from the selection on 2026-10-23; no recording of the clock itself was kept. Both agricultural science builds select batched swings (5 output swings per cycle) since a loss trial short only late in its 40 periods runs on, one clock for both: recorded on it on 2026-10-24, 400 in every period from the staged start and from the prepared one, and no difference between the game and the simulator in either (they were of the 2-swing clock before).
